tasks.title: Fix Login component prop contract and App.tsx view initialisation
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Fix two bugs that break the test suite — (a) `onGoToSignup` is a required prop on `Login` but every test renders `<Login onLogin={…} />` without it, causing `tsc --noEmit` to fail; (b) `App.tsx` initialises the `view` state from `window.location.pathname`, which can resolve to an unexpected value in jsdom and in the browser. 2. READ FIRST: `src/components/Login.tsx` (LoginProps interface, button that uses onGoToSignup), `src/components/Login.test.tsx` (all six render calls missing the prop), `src/App.tsx` (view useState initialiser on line 17–19). 3. FILES: Modify `src/components/Login.tsx` — change `onGoToSignup: () => void` to `onGoToSignup?: () => void` in the `LoginProps` interface, and update the button's onClick to `onClick={onGoToSignup ?? (() => {})}` so it remains safe. Modify `src/App.tsx` — replace the lazy initialiser `() => window.location.pathname === '/signup' ? 'signup' : 'login'` with the simple default `'login'`; the existing `onGoToSignup` handler in App already calls `window.history.pushState` when navigating, so URL-based initialisation is not needed. No new files needed. 4. APPROACH: Making the prop optional is the minimal, non-breaking fix — existing callers in App.tsx already pass the prop so nothing regresses there. The App.tsx change removes the sole source of environment-dependent initialisation. 5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing optional-prop pattern already used for `className` in `Button.tsx` (`className?: string`). After making both changes, also write or update the test in `src/components/Login.test.tsx` to add `onGoToSignup={vi.fn()}` to all six `render(<Login …>)` calls as belt-and-suspenders, matching the style of `Signup.test.tsx` which already passes both required props.
acceptance_criteria: The Login form is visible and contains Email and Password input fields when the app loads
Entering wrong credentials and clicking Login shows an 'Invalid email or password' error on screen
Entering correct credentials (test@gmail.com / test123) and clicking Login navigates away from the login form
A 'Sign up' link or button is present on the login form

tasks.title: Run full test suite and TypeScript check
tasks.description: Run the complete Vitest test suite and TypeScript compiler check to confirm all tests pass after the Login bugfix. Execute in order: 1. `npx vitest run` — all test files must pass with zero failures. 2. `npx tsc --noEmit` — must exit 0 with no type errors. Report the full output of any failing test or type error.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0 and all tests pass
npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0 and reports no type errors
